name: MINA! A Phone Story
source:
MINA! NTR Phone Story is a story-driven NTR/NTS game about you and your aspiring popstar girlfriend Mina.

As usual for the phone game genre, the entire game unfolds through a simulated phone interface: You’ll experience your connection through text messages and photos

Your relationship with Mina can change depending on how you respond.    Will you try to keep things under control… or watch as things slowly begin to spiral?  The way your relationship unfolds from here is decided by your choices.

[From [url=https://dramaticdonut.itch.io/mina-a-phone-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
米娜！NTR Phone Story是一款故事驱动的NTR/NTS游戏，讲述你和你有抱负的流行歌星女友米娜的故事。

与手机游戏类型一样，整个游戏通过模拟手机界面展开：你将通过短信和照片体验连接

你与米娜的关系可能会根据你的反应而改变。你会尝试控制事情……还是看着事情慢慢开始螺旋式上升？你们的关系从这里展开的方式取决于你的选择。

[来自[url=https://dramaticdonut.itch.io/mina-a-phone-story]Itch.io[/url]]
